title: Falcons to start third QB as Tua Tagovailoa, Michael Penix Jr. ruled out

sources.title: Falcons to start third QB as Tua Tagovailoa, Michael Penix Jr. ruled out
sources.description: Tua Tagovailoa has been ruled out for the Falcons' Week 1 game against the Steelers after suffering an injury in practice.
